results.question: Trong 2020–2022, shipping fee và transit time theo vùng thay đổi ra sao?

citations.title: Commerce SQL aggregate: Nationwide logistics
citations.sql_query: SELECT g.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.delivery_date) AS year, AVG(s.shipping_fee) AS avg_shipping_fee, AVG(s.delivery_date - s.ship_date) AS avg_transit_time_days FROM commerce.shipments AS s JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON s.order_id = o.order_id JOIN commerce.geography AS g ON o.zip = g.zip WHERE s.delivery_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' GROUP BY g.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.delivery_date) ORDER BY g.region, year LIMIT 100
citations.dataset_note: Synthetic Kaggle Datathon 2026 Round 1 Commerce data; not observed results from a real retailer.
